description: Turn a WIA Pin Code (12-digit v2 or 9-digit v1, dashes optional, a leading country calling code such as 082- is ignored) into latitude/longitude. v2 returns the cell centre (error within about ±10 m lat / ±20 m lng); v1 is a coarser legacy code.
name: pin_code_decode
title: WIA Pin Code: code → coordinates
